derivation: feminine of the same as H7276 (רֶגֶם);
def: a pile (of stones), i.e. (figuratively) a throng

occurrences.text: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
